root_cause: The protected canonical delivery admission classified the root .gitignore path as unclassified and failed closed. No broadened wildcard should be introduced.
fix: Classify exactly .gitignore as protected backend delivery path, without accepting any other hidden file. Keep code and regression in Required and CodeQL; only then re-evaluate the rejected ignore-file PR.
prevention_rule: All security-critical root ignore modifications must be classified through the same protected backend delivery admission. Unknown hidden paths remain fail-closed.
terminal_rule: Protected Required and CodeQL on exact final SHA plus merged-main verification; no bypass of admission or forced writes.
